originality.rationale: The original model paper explicitly identifies the power cutoff as unexplored; it lacks extremal-degree and maximizing-label results. Broad fixed-weight recursive tree maximum-degree theory does not imply a time-dependent age exclusion result; classical random recursive tree theorems cover only the baseline. published-finding corpus and own-ledger claim comparisons identified no dominating formula; historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: Unindexed or unpublished work on maximal degrees under moving age cutoffs might cover the phase transition.
The earliest Devroye--Lu 1995 and other older primary papers were not all read in complete full text; their unrestricted scope is not a proof of absence of broader generalized results.
The location exponent may be independently obtainable from generalized extreme-value frameworks not uncovered in these searches.
